answer: Because each pulse escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the basalt ledger records every share and the jetty audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 140 aliases means 140 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
